h1: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 48 m²

blocks.text: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 48 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed and completed a comprehensive interior project for a 48 m² apartment, including interior design, turnkey renovation, custom furniture production and final decoration.

The main objective was to create a functional and comfortable living environment within a relatively compact apartment. The layout and interior solutions were developed with a strong focus on ergonomics, efficient use of every square meter and visual consistency throughout the space.

Particular attention was given to custom-made furniture, designed specifically for the dimensions and characteristics of the apartment. Tailor-made furniture solutions help maximize the available space, provide practical storage and maintain a consistent interior style.

The project was completed as a comprehensive process — from the development of the interior concept and technical documentation to renovation works, custom furniture manufacturing and installation, and final interior decoration. This approach helps ensure that the completed interior remains consistent with the original design concept.
The page features photos of the completed interior and custom-made furniture, demonstrating the final result of the comprehensive work on this 48 m² apartment.
